name: Amansara
insider_take: Former guest villa of King Norodom Sihanouk, this intimate 24-suite sanctuary sits just 10 minutes from the legendary Angkor Wat temple complex.
whats_special: Originally built in the 1960s as the royal retreat, Amansara retains its regal heritage with modernist Khmer architecture and private courtyards. Each suite features terrazzo floors, reflecting pools, and floor-to-ceiling windows that blur the lines between indoor and outdoor living. The property's exclusive location provides unparalleled access to UNESCO World Heritage temples.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise excursion to Angkor Wat—Amansara's expert guides know the best vantage points to avoid crowds and capture that iconic temple silhouette emerging from the morning mist.
dont_miss: The traditional Khmer cooking class in Amansara's organic garden, followed by a private helicopter tour over the vast Angkor Archaeological Park—you'll spot hidden temples invisible from ground level that even seasoned Cambodia travelers never see.
pros: Prime location minutes from Angkor Wat temples
Former guest residence of King Sihanouk with historic charm
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Tranquil oasis with lush gardens and reflective pools
cons: Limited dining variety with focus on refined cuisine
